decision: Bartlett Ops Brain repo distribution is strictly local, ever — no public remote.
rationale: Confirmed directly with Mikey when scaffolding the repo. Keeps the secrets/PII bar simple while .gitignore still enforces it as defense-in-depth.
reversalConditions: Mikey explicitly asks to push to a private remote for backup or multi-machine access.

decision: Auto-commit stays OFF by default; every commit is a deliberate, asked-for action.
rationale: Mikey wants to review a run of manual commits before trusting an agent to commit unattended.
reversalConditions: Mikey reviews several manual commits and explicitly asks for auto-commit-on-important-changes.

decision: server/server.js uses only Node's built-in modules (http, fs, path, url, crypto) — no Express, no npm install.
rationale: Matches the existing searchops-helper/server.js pattern already in use for this account, and aligns with the safety rule against running third-party code blindly.
reversalConditions: A concrete feature genuinely requires a dependency Node's stdlib can't reasonably provide.

decision: Cowork access is via the existing 'Copy Cowork brief' read flow plus a paste-back Memory tab, not live remote sync.
rationale: Reconciles 'wire up Cowork access' with 'strictly local, ever' — true remote sync would require a private git remote, out of scope for this pass.
reversalConditions: Mikey wants real-time Cowork read/write against this exact file tree; would require revisiting the local-only decision.
